header: Everything in the author agreement, section by section

items.title: Copyright and licensing
items.content: Authors keep copyright. Northstar Labs publishes under CC BY-NC 4.0 and registers a DOI within 48 hours of acceptance. Reuse in a thesis or a classroom pack needs no further permission.

items.title: Embargo and preprint policy
items.content: Preprints may stay on any server. The accepted version appears in the Lodestar archive on the issue date, and the full text opens to every reader 12 months later.

items.title: Fees and reprint rights
items.content: There is no submission or publication fee. Commercial reprints of a single article are quoted per print run, and the rights desk replies within five working days.
